recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5762 unless Pharmacy reopens the broader DosageDetails design; the stale SVG mention is not a standalone authoritative-source fix.
issue_request: FHIR-5762 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked to add text dosage instructions on MedicationDispense; the Jira comment supported consistency with Prescription.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5762 was found. Historical source shows the request was applied in substance when MedicationDispense.renderedDosageInstruction was added as a full representation of dosage instructions.
additional_context: Later R6 dosage work introduced DosageDetails, moved renderedDosageInstruction to DosageDetails.renderedInstruction, and then made renderedInstruction required. MedicationDispense remains an active build resource and its dosageInstruction now uses DosageDetails.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current authoritative source already carries required human-readable dispense dosage text via MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction -> DosageDetails.renderedInstruction, with Dosage.text still available for free-text SIG content.
